GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.112 (6 May 46) DS
(SCAPIN - 925)
APO 500
6 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Status of Japanese Consul General in Dublin.
The Imperial Japanese Government is hereby directed to notify the Irish Government through the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and through the Swiss Government that the former Japanese Consul General at Dublin no longer holds official position. The Imperial Japanese Government is to order the Japanese Consul General to obey the American Legation's written instructions to him.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
